experience.title: Quantum reservoir computing
points: Developed an operator-valued Volterra framework and numerical diagnostics to identify temporal features accessible through measurement.
Designed a local, prethermal Floquet reservoir for classical-shadow readout and analyzed the tradeoff between memory persistence and feature visibility.

experience.title: Quantum-neural hybrid variational algorithms
points: Investigated error-mitigation capabilities of neural post-processing using convolutional neural networks through the IonQ research mentorship program.
Identified finite-shot limits of diagonal neural reweighting, developed a unitary phase-based alternative that preserves the variational bound, and tested it on spin models.

experience.title: Software architecture for trapped-ion quantum computers
points: Developed software linking circuit submission, compilation, scheduling, hardware dispatch, and result processing for laboratory trapped-ion hardware.
Built a Qiskit-compatible client and contributed to experiment-control software used in the QuIQCL laboratory.

experience.title: Quantum AI for automated driving
experience.context: Joint research with Hyundai Motor Group
points: Explored quantum machine learning approaches to automated driving in a joint research project.
Combined quantum edge detection with Faster R-CNN for a fast object detection algorithm.
